text: The X-ray showing dilated loops with no gas in the rectum and a normal sweat chloride test strongly points towards Hirschsprung disease rather than meconium ileum or duodenal atresia. To confirm this diagnosis and visualize the transition zone, I will request a contrast enema. REQUEST TEST: Contrast_Enema

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal contrast enema makes Hirschsprung disease less likely, so I need to rule out other causes of distal obstruction. I will now request a rectal suction biopsy to definitively check for the absence of ganglion cells. REQUEST TEST: Rectal_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Rectal_Biopsy: Absence of ganglion cells in the submucosa and myenteric plexus, consistent with Hirschsprung’s disease.
